Starting point: Identify which marketing domains resonate and are interesting to you to learn. 

Read: Brian Balfour’s “How to Become a UA (user acquisition) Expert” can help identify what you’re interested in, and links to many other high quality blogs: https://brianbalfour.com/essays/customer-acquisition

Whether you want to build a startup or not, these cover every stage of one and can also help you identify skills you’re interested in developing and offering: 

Read: 0-100 Matrix Growth: https://www.forentrepreneurs.com/matrix-growth-academy-zero-to-100-videos/
Watch: YC Startup school: https://www.startupschool.org
Read: Julian Shapiro’s Startup Handbook: https://www.julian.com/guide/startup/intro

Want to build an online e-commerce business? Hands down @BowTiedBull 
Start on this with selecting an online niche: https://bowtiedbull.io/p/wifi-money-niche-selection-and-assets
On building an audience from zero: https://bowtiedbull.io/p/ecom-building-an-audience-from-zero
Search “ecom” “e-com” “WiFi money” on their newsletter for more 

With e-commerce, there’s specific skills to develop you can narrow down on, many covered in the first link too. Up to you if you’re deciding to double down on a marketing skill (e.g. SEO expert, copywriter) or building an ecom store start to finish

The rest here are more niche content if you want to dive in on specific domains. Some of my personal favorites and my own plug on web3 marketing: 
- Copywriting and behavioral psychology: Read book Ca$hvertising 
- Designing landing pages that convert: https://www.julian.com/guide/startup/landing-pages
- Meta ads: Sugantan’s post, from 2018 but solid insights. Spending $1mm/month on Ecom, oldie but goodie: https://sugatan.io/lessons-learned-spending-1mm-month-on-facebook-ads/
- Bonus add of Chatgpt prompting: Stefan’s Georgi, great prompt for ad hooks: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9SpnpoqoAMo
- @lennysan ‘s newsletter for product marketing, learning about retention loops and acquisition. Can also be helpful if you consult on growth marketing for products. One of my fav post: https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/how-duolingo-reignited-user-growth
- Newsletter marketing, great post on Milk Road’s UA tactics by @denk_tweets : https://blog.beehiiv.com/p/milk-road-newsletter-acquisition
- Twitter growth and social media management. Read @ishverduzco ‘s pinned tweet 
- Web3 marketing: I’ve had the last 2+ years working at Hype (@hypepartners ) to oversee growth for L1/L2s, nfts, ecosystems, hardware, gaming, marketplaces, dapps and dexs. Check my highlights on Twitter -or- search “@emilylai web3.” Dms open if you have questions 

One key tip: Don’t get lost in frameworks and theory you see online. There’s also a ton of junk. Tweet hooks everywhere about prompts or tools that can change your life for example. Just identify on the skills you want to develop, focus on learning how to execute, get opportunities to test and refine these skills, show results, and use results to gain more opportunities
